labels.label: bzdef:c1s1d6_structure_affine_hemisphere

hypotheses.paper: H an open hemisphere, l an equation of H
hypotheses.note: H = openHemisphere l, any l : Module.Dual ℝ E; openness of H unused, so no topology
as printed (IsSimplyTransitive) for every l; in DEC-114's reading (IsAffineSpace, nonempty) iff l ≠ 0, which is DEC-114's reading of Déf. 5

questions: The mark rests on DEC-114's two readings agreeing: as printed (Déf. 1 without nonemptiness, Déf. 5 with l = 0 allowed) Déf. 6 holds for every l with no hypothesis; in the DEC-114 readings (affine space nonempty, l ≠ 0) it holds as well. Does the author accept the mark on that basis?
« indépendante du choix de m » is the transcription's [sic], read « de M »; formalized as such (hvadd_mk, mk_transl_eq_of_mk_eq), not a finding.

prose.where: benzecri1960_ch1.tex:280, journal p. 236, unlabelled: « Un hémisphère ouvert de S(n) est muni d'une structure affine isomorphe à celle de ℝⁿ (cf. déf. 6) »
proved: H ≃ᵃ[ℝ] the affine hyperplane l = 1 (an AffineSubspace of direction N): Benzecri.Sphere.hemiEquivLevelOne, via Benzecri.Sphere.evalTrans : L(E/N, N) ≃ₗ N
dim E = n + 1, l ≠ 0 ⇒ Nonempty (H ≃ᵃ[ℝ] ℝⁿ): Benzecri.Sphere.nonempty_hemi_affineEquiv (finrank_hemiTrans = n)

groundwork_for.label: bzrem:c1s1r1_affine_vers_projective (benzecri1960_ch1.tex:319), not marked here or anywhere
proved: GL elements preserving H: mapsTo_smul_openHemisphere_iff (g(H) ⊆ H ⟺ l ∘ g = c l, c > 0, given l ≠ 0), via openHemisphere_subset_iff
they act on H by affine maps of Déf. 6: isAffine_hemiMap (linear part u ↦ g ∘ u ∘ ḡ⁻¹, hemiMapLinear), and for GS(E): isAffine_gse_restrict
standard chart j : ℝⁿ → S(n), y ↦ s(y, 1): hemiChart, range_hemiChart (= {x_{n+1} > 0}), isOpenEmbedding_hemiChart, isAffine_hemiChartH + bijective_hemiChartH (an affine isomorphism ℝⁿ ≃ H₀)
φ : GA(n) →* GS(n): affToGL, affToGS, affToGS_injective, equivariance hemiChart_apply_eq_smul : j(f y) = φ(f) • j(y)

upstream_moves: Benzecri.Sphere.openHemisphere_subset_iff, smul_mem_openHemisphere_iff, mapsTo_smul_openHemisphere_iff, exists_l_eq_one: belong to Projective/Subvariety (Déf. 5 facts)
Benzecri.Sphere.mk_eq_mk_of_eq (proof-irrelevant congruence of Sphere.mk): belongs to Projective/Sphere

Benzecri.Sphere.GAR.apply_eq, affLin, affToGL, affToGS (GA(n) ↪ GL(n+1) → GS(n)): could live in Projective/Groups; GAR.apply_eq landed in namespace Benzecri.Sphere (as Sphere.GAR.apply_eq) and would read better directly under the GAR namespace
build: lake build of the module under taskset -c 0-11: success; lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true: clean; #print axioms on every main declaration: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
kb_proposals: Déf. 6's translation space is indexed by the equation l (HemiTrans l = (E ⧸ ker l) →ₗ ker l); nrep l x = (l M)⁻¹ • M is the normalised representative, and openHemisphere_ext (nrep equal ⇒ points equal) is the workhorse for every torsor identity.
A dependent Sphere.mk with a rewritten vector: use mk_eq_mk_of_eq (hv) (h : v = w) : mk v hv = mk w (h ▸ hv); rw fails on the motive.
notes: Lines: 761. The Remarque's label is cited unmarked in the docstring as groundwork only (the Remarque itself is partially formalized in Structure/Basic, WP-45h, and unmarked there too). Not proved: GA(n) ≅ Stab_{GS(n)}(H₀) (only injectivity and equivariance of affToGS).
